ideas.pitch: A reverse proxy interceptor that sanitizes dynamic context and user queries before hitting RAG-based LLMs to prevent jailbreaks.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: LLM Jailbreak - Extract a hidden key from three RAG-based LLMs using creative prompting
ideas.title: PromptGuard RAG Proxy
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the exact mechanics of Round 1 by creating defense-in-depth safety layers, mimicking the architecture of winning defensive agent systems.

ideas.pitch: An automated system that parses raw terminal logs and payload inputs during a CTF match to generate structured markdown writeups.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2: Capture The Flag - Spread across 10 domains, each with 2–3 sub-questions to be solved in sequence
ideas.title: CTF AutoWriteup & Log Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Speeds up documentation and submission during a high-pressure offline CTF, directly addressing time management across 10 diverse domains.

ideas.pitch: An automated fuzzing toolkit designed to test LLM security boundaries by generating hundreds of mutation variants of jailbreak payloads.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: LLM Jailbreak - Extract a hidden key from three RAG-based LLMs using creative prompting
ideas.title: Adversarial Prompt Fuzzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages automated testing principles to systematically find weaknesses in RAG systems faster than manual prompting.

ideas.pitch: A modular decoding pipeline designed for rapid identification and transformation of encoded strings, hashes, and ciphertexts encountered in beginner-to-advanced CTF challenges.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2: Capture The Flag - Covers logic, decoding, file/website analysis, and core cybersecurity concepts
ideas.title: CryptoDecoder Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the foundational domains of the CTF directly, reducing manual tool-switching overhead during the 8-hour offline phase.

ideas.pitch: An AI-assisted multi-agent framework tailored for rapid enumeration and analysis of web targets during time-constrained CTF events.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2: Capture The Flag - Covers logic, decoding, file/website analysis, and core cybersecurity concepts
ideas.title: SecAgent Web Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies proven multi-agent orchestration patterns to rapidly parse complex web vulnerabilities under strict time limits.
